facts.did: 在 Fourth Exam 行程中拥抱 cluster 后，前往 Harvest 顶端的考试塔，为题为 First Observations of Complex Food Webs on a Tectonically Active Planet Inside the Galactic Plane 的论文答辩
facts.anchor: headed to the examination tower at the top of Harvest

facts.did: Spiralstair 代替缺席的导师 Plumline，另两位考官由 Gardenpath 自选为 Arch 与 Column，Column 充当 outside examiner
facts.anchor: stood in for their mercifully absent adviser, Plumline

facts.did: 提出全场唯一的真正挑战：问其关于有意识多细胞生物的观察会如何影响 Rational People 对单细胞生命的理解
facts.anchor: how their observations of conscious multicellularity would

facts.did: 宣布这篇论文 exceptional、是 truly exceptional work，并欢迎其继续参加 Fifth
facts.anchor: welcome you to continue onward and sit for the Fifth

facts.did: 回应 Gardenpath 关于武器原型与设计图纸下落的追问，承认图纸最终落到 Galleon Cloud People 手中
facts.anchor: they wound up in the possession of the Galleon Cloud People

facts.did: 插话称极不可能：他们得从 Tentacle 采集 director cells，以其有限技术能力做不到
facts.anchor: would need to harvest those director cells from Tentacle

facts.did: 公开自己膜上的感光器，说自己欠一个光合生物一条命，是它养大了自己并找到探测器送自己回来
facts.anchor: I owe my life to a photosynthesizer.

facts.did: 警告不要低估 Cloud People：他们有能力造出这件武器，且它可能就在外面
facts.anchor: you should not underestimate the Cloud People

relations.relation: 原文明确写 Plumline 用 Gardenpath 的部分工作设计武器，并打算用它同 Galleon Cloud People 交换以支持其战争
relations.anchor: Plumline used part of my work to design a weapon

relations.relation: 原文明确写三人互相对视，房间里弥漫着焦虑的气味
relations.anchor: Column, Arch, and Spiralstair trained eyes on each other

relations.relation: 原文明确写 Cloud People 已经打了数代人的战争
relations.anchor: The Cloud People have been at war for generations

relations.relation: 原文明确写是它养大了 Gardenpath，并找到探测器把它送回这里
relations.anchor: They raised me, and found a probe to send me back here

relations.relation: 原文明确写希望几个 journeys 后再见到其参加 Fifth
relations.anchor: see you in a few journeys when you sit for the Fifth

numbers.fact: 这是第四次考试（Fourth Exam）的行程
numbers.anchor: On the journey of their Fourth Exam

numbers.fact: Spiralstair 说其已赢得参加 Fifth 的权利
numbers.anchor: You have earned the right to take the Fifth.

numbers.fact: Spiralstair 认为一个原型不会造成差别
numbers.anchor: I don’t think one prototype will make a difference

numbers.fact: 原文称 Cloud People 只比光合生物高一步
numbers.anchor: They are only one step above the photosynthesizers
